stages.label: Wally decision
stages.description: Opportunity / direction / conviction. Decision-layer input to Wolf.

stages.label: Wolf action
stages.description: wolf_action_type + intended direction/quantity/reference price. The ONLY component allowed to signal the adapter.

stages.label: Binance paper order
stages.description: Order submitted to Binance paper/testnet. POST /api/v3/order, newClientOrderId = wolf_<hash>.

stages.label: Acknowledgement

stages.label: Fill

stages.label: Position
stages.description: Reconciled position vs exchange balance (binary presence + base-asset size, ±5% tolerance).

stages.label: PnL
stages.description: Realized / unrealized PnL. Absent PnL and zero PnL are different facts and render differently.
